mapper.select: SELECT cc.contract_chat_id, oiv.name AS ownerName, CONCAT_WS(' ', oiv.addr1, oiv.addr2) AS ownerAddr, oiv.phone_number AS ownerPhoneNum, biv.name AS buyerName, CONCAT_WS(' ', biv.addr1, biv.addr2) AS buyerAddr, biv.phone_number AS buyerPhoneNum, h.addr1 AS homeAddr1, h.addr2 AS homeAddr2, h.residence_type, h.exclusive_area, h.deposit_price, h.monthly_rent, h.maintenance_fee, hd.home_floor, tpc.expected_move_in_date AS contractStartDate FROM contract_chat cc LEFT JOIN identity_verification oiv ON oiv.user_id = cc.owner_id AND oiv.contract_id = cc.contract_chat_id LEFT JOIN identity_verification biv ON biv.user_id = cc.buyer_id AND biv.contract_id = cc.contract_chat_id LEFT JOIN home h ON cc.home_id = h.home_id LEFT JOIN home_detail hd ON cc.home_id = hd.home_id LEFT JOIN tenant_precontract_check tpc ON cc.contract_chat_id = tpc.contract_chat_id WHERE cc.contract_chat_id = #{contractChatId}
SELECT fc.contract_id FROM contract_chat cc INNER JOIN final_contract fc ON cc.home_id = fc.home_id AND cc.owner_id = fc.owner_id WHERE cc.contract_chat_id = #{contractChatId}
mapper.insert: insert into final_contract (contract_id, home_id, owner_id, buyer_id, owner_identity_verified_at, buyer_identity_verified_at, deposit_price, monthly_rent, maintenance_fee, created_at) select #{contractChatId}, cc.home_id, cc.owner_id, cc.buyer_id, oiv.identity_verified_at, biv.identity_verified_at, #{depositPrice}, #{monthlyRent}, #{maintenanceFee}, NOW() FROM contract_chat cc LEFT JOIN identity_verification oiv ON oiv.user_id = cc.owner_id AND oiv.contract_id = cc.contract_chat_id LEFT JOIN identity_verification biv ON biv.user_id = cc.buyer_id AND biv.contract_id = cc.contract_chat_id WHERE cc.contract_chat_id = #{contractChatId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.lease_type AS leaseType, hd.land_category AS landCategory, hd.area AS area, -- rc.purpose AS purpose, -- rc.total_floor_area AS totalFloorArea, opc.has_tax_arrears AS hasTaxArrears, opc.has_prior_fixed_date AS hasPriorFixedDate, owi.payment_due_day AS paymentDueDay, CONCAT(opc.owner_bank_name, ' ', opc.owner_account_number) AS bankAccount, tpc.expected_move_in_date AS expectedMoveInDate, CURDATE() AS contractDate, tpc.contract_duration AS contractDuration, oiv.ssn_front AS ownerSsnFront, oiv.ssn_back AS ownerSsnBack, biv.ssn_front AS buyerSsnFront, biv.ssn_back AS buyerSsnBack FROM contract_chat cc LEFT JOIN home h ON cc.home_id = h.home_id LEFT JOIN home_detail hd ON cc.home_id = hd.home_id LEFT JOIN risk_check rc ON rc.home_id = cc.home_id AND rc.checked_at >= CURDATE() AND rc.checked_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY LEFT JOIN owner_precontract_check opc ON cc.contract_chat_id = opc.contract_chat_id LEFT JOIN owner_wolse_info owi ON cc.contract_chat_id = owi.contract_chat_id LEFT JOIN tenant_precontract_check tpc ON cc.contract_chat_id = tpc.contract_chat_id LEFT JOIN identity_verification oiv ON oiv.user_id = cc.owner_id AND oiv.contract_id = cc.contract_chat_id LEFT JOIN identity_verification biv ON biv.user_id = cc.buyer_id AND biv.contract_id = cc.contract_chat_id WHERE cc.contract_chat_id = #{contractChatId}

SELECT home_id, owner_id, buyer_id, contract_pdf_key, contract_pdf_hash, contract_date, contract_expire_date, owner_identity_verified_at, buyer_identity_verified_at, deposit_price, monthly_rent, maintenance_fee, created_at FROM final_contract WHERE contract_id = #{contractChatId}
mapper.insert: insert into electronic_signature (contract_id, identity_verification_id, signature_file_key, signature_file_hash, signed_type, created_at) select #{contractChatId}, iv.identity_id , #{s3Key}, #{hashKey}, #{signedType},NOW() FROM contract_chat cc JOIN identity_verification iv ON iv.contract_id = cc.contract_chat_id WHERE cc.contract_chat_id = #{contractChatId} AND iv.user_id= #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT es.signature_id AS signatureId, es.contract_id AS contractId, es.identity_verification_id AS identityVerificationId, es.signature_file_key AS signatureFileKey, es.signature_file_hash AS signatureFileHash, es.signed_type AS signedType, es.created_at AS createdAt FROM electronic_signature es JOIN identity_verification iv ON iv.identity_id = es.identity_verification_id WHERE es.contract_id = #{contractChatId} AND iv.user_id = #{userId}
